Class Activity

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.core.Activity
public final class Activity extends Object
Who is really playing: a player counts as active while they turned their view in the last AFK_MINUTES minutes. Being pushed by water or standing in a mob farm moves a player but never turns their head, so plugins that pay for time played (the pass, playtime goals) ask isActive(UUID) first. 
if (Activity.isActive(uuid)) { addMinutePlayed(uuid); }
A player who has just joined counts as active. Core samples everyone online every few seconds; asked from any thread.
